Use with caution / monitor [tramadol:drug_interactions:2].

Fluoxetine is a potent inhibitor of the CYP2D6 enzyme pathway [fluoxetine:drug_interactions:0], which is involved in the metabolism of tramadol [tramadol:clinical_pharmacology:13]. Concomitant use with a CYP2D6 inhibitor like fluoxetine can require monitoring and adjusting intervals for adverse reactions, including seizures and serotonin syndrome [tramadol:drug_interactions:2].
